summary: Stock BYH3 cmupmucal.ko g3dcore_on/off/status/cmu_init tables decoded and equal to the pinned source; exynos-pd_el3 DTZPC SMC 0x82000410 args (1|0, id, 2), restore then HVC 0xC6000108 via exynos_pd_restore_s2mpu; exynos-hypervisor.ko hyp HVC handler is a plugin pointer, SMC trap only 0x82002910/11 (others to EL3); plugin is Samsung uH (el2_code 0xC1400000 2 MiB, compatible el2,uh; s2mpu_table 0xC5000000). First GPU step values are stock-traceable; S2MPU HVCs need uH under pKVM (owner piece G7). GPU ID register offsets still open. First read after power-on: GRBM_CHIP_REVISION at PA 0x22208084 (reg_offset GC seg0 0x1260 + 0xdc1, stock nbio_v2_3_get_chip_revision), expected 0x02600200 from stock DT chip_revision (EVT1 -> evt1 firmware).

commands.cmd: llvm-readelf -s/-S cmupmucal.ko + struct pmucal_seq decode (80 B)

limits: whether EL3 answers these SMCs from XNU is unmeasured
